name: pkgticker
description: PkgTicker — per-day downloads table for GitHub & npm (Chrome extension)

scripts.dist: rm -f pkgticker.zip && zip -rq -X pkgticker.zip manifest.json background.js inject.js icons -x '*.DS_Store' && unzip -Z1 pkgticker.zip | node tools/check-dist.js && unzip -l pkgticker.zip
